panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Axial T2-FLAIR of a real patient with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis demonstrating left mesial/inferior temporal hyperintensity (red arrow), a recognized limbic MRI finding. In-text text describes the study as suggestive of early encephalitis in keeping with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis; MRI abnormalities are non-specific but the article diagnosis supports attribution. B: Coronal T2-FLAIR of the same patient showing left temporal/inferior temporal signal abnormality with red-arrow annotation, consistent with limbic encephalitis in this biopsy/serology-confirmed anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis case.
